sourceFormat: Exact UTF-8 campaign helper bytes for replay in the archived common/server capsule; not a serving module

visibility.input: own six creature identities, own doctrine/artifacts/budget, complete public opponent creature identities, map and public synergy variants, physical seat
visibility.excluded: actual opponent doctrine, artifacts, upgrades, splits, quantities, positions and actual combat seed
visibility.enemyBeliefs: three fixed hypothetical builds from the legal input; not posterior estimates and not actual hidden opponent information
visibility.draft: unchanged locked V3 plus adopted contextual draft; no Setup roster leaked backwards
visibility.nativeSetup: RANKED_PLACEMENT_OPTIONS; authoritative public ranked commitBotSetupForTeam; 1000 experience per original creature; hidden positions

planRules.PlacementLevel: fixed to incumbent; no new placement purchase
planRules.budget: exact doctrine-funded incumbent total; caps and quantities checked
planRules.spending: one point transferred from lowest role-affinity funded donor to Movement, Empower if magic, or dominant physical attack axis; Armor never below one
planRules.formation: unchanged authoritative current placer on the selected funded army

responses: Battle Trance, Swift Boots + Crown of Command, mobility plan
Scout, Iron Plate + Titan Plate, current plan
Spymaster, Mage Ring + Archmage Ring when magic count exceeds ranged count; otherwise Hunter Longbow + Farsight, support singles plan

search.selection: highest mean paired gain among eligible plans, ties keep earlier index, otherwise incumbent
search.choiceLock: every family/seat decision locked and raw hashes sealed before any actual evaluation preparation

inference.subgroupIntervals: diagnostic; only own-doctrine nonnegative means are gates
inference.duplicatePolicyChoices: exact same frozen fightNative consumed inputs plus combat seed and scoring seat reuse the first verified raw record; full raw/receipt/turn/event/health links retained; logical outcomes and newly simulated fights reported separately
inference.teacherTransfer: hypothetical selection results and actual evaluation results remain separate
